f3_program: consume("akeno_apartment_furnishing", "akeno", at("akeno.money.dollars", "current"), 2985, source("Akeno spent $2985 to furnish his apartment"))
consume("lev_apartment_furnishing", "lev", at("lev.money.dollars", "current"), "lev.apartment_furnishing.spending.dollars", source("Lev spent one-third of that amount on his apartment"))
fraction_of(event_field("lev_apartment_furnishing", "quantity"), event_field("akeno_apartment_furnishing", "quantity"), 1, 3, source("Lev spent one-third of that amount on his apartment"))
consume("ambrocio_apartment_furnishing", "ambrocio", at("ambrocio.money.dollars", "current"), "ambrocio.apartment_furnishing.spending.dollars", source("Ambrocio spent $177 less than Lev"))
offset(event_field("ambrocio_apartment_furnishing", "quantity"), event_field("lev_apartment_furnishing", "quantity"), -177, "dollar", source("Ambrocio spent $177 less than Lev"))

sum_relation("lev_and_ambrocio.apartment_furnishing.spending.dollars", event_field("lev_apartment_furnishing", "quantity"), event_field("ambrocio_apartment_furnishing", "quantity"), source("the other 2 people combined"))
query("difference", "lev_and_ambrocio.apartment_furnishing.spending.dollars", event_field("akeno_apartment_furnishing", "quantity"))
collection("deshaun.summer_books_read", "book", "summer_break", source("he read 60 books over the summer"))
observe(at("summer_break.duration", "summer_break"), 80, "day", source("Summer break is 80 days long"))
observe(at("deshaun.summer_books_read.count", "summer_break"), 60, "count", source("he read 60 books over the summer"))
observe(at("deshaun.summer_books_read.average_length", "summer_break"), 320, "page", source("Each book averaged 320 pages long"))
percent_of(at("second_reader.reading.amount", "summer_break"), at("deshaun.reading.amount", "summer_break"), 75, source("The person closest to him read 75% as much as he did"))
query("value", at("second_reader.pages_read.average_per_day", "summer_break"))
assumptions: The source does not specify whether "75% as much" refers to books or pages, and it does not explicitly state that the second reader's books share DeShaun's 320-page average.

f3_program: collection("hector.container.gumballs", "gumball", "hector.container", source("a container of gumballs"))
add("purchase_gumballs", "hector", at("hector.container.gumballs.count", "current"), "hector.container.gumballs.purchased.count", source("Hector purchased a container of gumballs"))
transfer("give_todd", "hector", at("hector.container.gumballs.count", "current"), at("todd.gumballs.count", "current"), 4, source("He gave 4 to Todd"))

transfer("give_alisha", "hector", at("hector.container.gumballs.count", "current"), at("alisha.gumballs.count", "current"), scale(event_field("give_todd", "quantity"), 2), source("then he gave twice as many as he had given Todd to Alisha"))

transfer("give_bobby", "hector", at("hector.container.gumballs.count", "current"), at("bobby.gumballs.count", "current"), "hector.container.gumballs.given_to_bobby.count", source("he gave 5 less than four times as many to Bobby as he had given to Alisha"))
offset(event_field("give_bobby", "quantity"), scale(event_field("give_alisha", "quantity"), 4), -5, "count", source("he gave 5 less than four times as many to Bobby as he had given to Alisha"))
observe(at("hector.container.gumballs.count", "current"), 6, "count", source("Hector had 6 gumballs remaining"))
query("value", event_field("purchase_gumballs", "quantity"))
collection("camp_wonka.campers", "camper", "camp_wonka", source("At camp Wonka, there are 96 campers"))
observe(at("camp_wonka.campers.count", "current"), 96, "count", source("there are 96 campers"))
collection("camp_wonka.campers.boys", "camper", "camp_wonka", source("Two-thirds of the campers are boys"))
fraction_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.boys.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.count", "current"), 2, 3, source("Two-thirds of the campers are boys"))
collection("camp_wonka.campers.girls", "camper", "camp_wonka", source("the remaining one-third are girls"))
fraction_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.girls.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.count", "current"), 1, 3, source("the remaining one-third are girls"))
percent_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.boys.want_toast_marshmallows.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.boys.count", "current"), 50, source("50% of the boys want to toast marshmallows"))
percent_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.girls.want_toast_marshmallows.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.girls.count", "current"), 75, source("75% of the girls want to toast marshmallows"))
observe(at("camp_wonka.marshmallows.per_camper", "toast"), 1, "marshmallow_per_camper", source("each camper gets one marshmallow to toast"))
query("value", at("camp_wonka.marshmallows.needed.count", "toast"))
assumptions: The phrase "each camper" could mean all 96 campers or only the campers who want to toast marshmallows; the source does not disambiguate the recipient group.

f3_program: observe(at("mikaela.tutoring.pay_rate", "current"), 10, "dollar_per_hour", source("Mikaela earns $10 an hour"))
observe(at("mikaela.tutoring.hours", "first_month"), 35, "hour", source("For the first month, she tutored for 35 hours"))
offset(at("mikaela.tutoring.hours", "second_month"), at("mikaela.tutoring.hours", "first_month"), 5, "hour", source("in the second month, she tutored 5 hours more than the first month"))

consume("personal_needs_spending", "mikaela", at("mikaela.money.dollars", "current"), fraction("mikaela.tutoring.earnings.total.dollars", 4, 5), source("She spent 4/5 of her total earnings on her personal needs"))
add("save_remaining_earnings", "mikaela", at("mikaela.savings.dollars", "current"), "mikaela.savings.saved.dollars", source("saved the rest of the money"))

difference_relation(event_field("save_remaining_earnings", "quantity"), "mikaela.tutoring.earnings.total.dollars", event_field("personal_needs_spending", "quantity"), source("saved the rest of the money"))
query("value", event_field("save_remaining_earnings", "quantity"))
assumptions: "her total earnings" refers to Mikaela's tutoring earnings from the first and second months described.
